description: This file defines the 'Subordinate' data transfer object (DTO) class within the Human Resource Management system, which is used to represent subordinate employee data in reports, including methods to retrieve and normalize subordinate information.

classes.name: Subordinate
classes.description: A DTO class representing subordinate employee data for reporting purposes, capable of normalizing subordinate information and handling reporting method logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Subordinate DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts subordinate data to an array based on specified fields, normalizing subordinate employee details.

methods.name: callGetterOnItem
methods.description: Retrieves specific attribute values for a subordinate employee, especially handling the 'subReportingMethod' field via a reporting method lookup.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of field names to their respective getter methods used for data extraction.
